specs.Cinema Is Coming Home: Inspired by Sony’s filmmaking expertise, the BRAVIA Theater Bar brings expressive sound and spatial detail that reflect the creator’s true vision.
specs.Dolby Atmos and DTS:X: Experience authentic cinema audio with support for Dolby Atmos and DTS:X, offering detailed sound placement for movies, shows, and games.
specs.Dedicated Center Speaker: Hear every word clearly through the center channel speaker, which enhances dialogue—from soft conversations to dramatic scenes.
specs.Vertical Surround Engine and S-Force Pro: Sony’s sound technologies create virtual vertical and horizontal surround effects, filling your room with immersive audio from a single slim unit.
specs.Wireless Subwoofer: The included wireless subwoofer boosts low-end frequencies, delivering deeper and more engaging bass for all types of entertainment.
specs.BRAVIA TV Compatibility: When paired with BRAVIA TVs, features like Voice Zoom 3 offer clearer speech and a more connected home-theatre experience.
specs.BRAVIA Connect App: Manage sound settings, modes, and volume easily through the BRAVIA Connect app, which also simplifies initial setup.
specs.Bluetooth Wireless Streaming: Stream your favorite music or podcasts wirelessly from smartphones and compatible devices using Bluetooth technology.
